planets.name: BD+20 594 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of BD+20 594 with a 41.7-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: BD+20 594 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around BD+20 594. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2016, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 41.6855, pl_radj 0.23, pl_bmassj 0.07

quotes.title: BD+20 594b
quotes.card: BD+20°594b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet discovered by the Kepler space telescope in collaboration with the HARPS spectrometer at La Silla in Chile.
